presets.name: Bench
presets.description: Desk testing with air unit and ground station close together: low TX power on every card (no receiver overload, less heat on a bare board), default link and video.

presets.name: Long range
presets.description: More robust radio: MCS 1 (QPSK 1/2) and more FEC recovery packets (8/14), with the bitrate lowered to 2.5 Mbit/s so the stream still fits. TX power is not changed: set it for your card on the Radio tab.

presets.name: Low latency
presets.description: Smaller FEC blocks (4/6) so the ground station waits for fewer packets before it can decode, and MCS 3 for headroom at 4.5 Mbit/s. Needs a strong signal: use at short range.
